description: The bar chart illustrates a "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment." The horizontal axis displays the categorical models being evaluated, ordered from left to right as "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude," with the text labels slightly rotated. The vertical axis represents the measured value, labeled "Runtime (seconds)," utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 400 with tick marks and corresponding dashed horizontal gridlines at regular intervals of 50. A legend in the upper left corner associates a dark green square with a blurred label and a light blue square with "LLM Models." Each category is represented by a single vertical bar outlined in black, with its exact numerical value annotated in bold text directly above it. The bars are not sorted by height or alphabetically. The first bar, "Our Joint Framework," is visually emphasized in dark green and is the shortest bar with a value of 77. The remaining four bars are colored light blue to represent the LLM Models: "ChatGPT" has a value of 190, "DeepSeek" is the tallest bar at 365, "LLaMA" is 172, and "Claude" is 243.
